title: ZA-2024-6024-CUW-1A
text:
ZA-2024-6024-CUW-1A  Council District: 4 – Raman
  CEQA: ENV-2024-6025-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-08-26
  Plan Area: Hollywood

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  2069 North Argyle Avenue

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  The installation of a new unmanned wireless telecommunications facility on the rooftop of an existing 54-
  foot-tall, five-story apartment building. The Project includes the installation of new Fiber-Reinforced

  Polymer (FRP) screen walls, nine panel antennas, 14 remote radio units (RRUs), one surge suppressor,
  one power plant cabinet, one data cabinet, one battery cabinet, one TELCO box, and one electrical panel
  on the rooftop. The Project also includes the installation of a new generator connector and an MTS
  disconnect switch at grade level, as well as a meter bank on the P3 level. The new FRP screen walls will
  be eight feet eight inches in height and will not extend above the existing 54-foot-tall apartment building.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the June 9, 2026 Zoning Administrator’s Determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15303, and Class
  3 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures), and there is no substantial evidence
  demonstrating that any exceptions contained in Section 15300.2 of the CEQA Guidelines regarding
  location, cumulative impacts, significant effects or unusual circumstances, scenic highways, or
  hazardous waste sites, or historical resources applies;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 W.49 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.2, of the Los
  Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Conditional Use to permit the installation, use, and maintenance of
  a new unmanned Wireless Telecommunications Facility (WTF) on the rooftop of an existing residential
  building in the R3-1XL Zone, with a height of 54 feet in lieu of the height limit of 30 feet required by
  Height District No. 1 XL; and
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Gary Bodenweiser, AT&T Mobility
  Representative: Jerry Ambrose, Eukon Group

  Appellant:  Catherine J. Ripp

  Staff:  Monique Acosta, Planning Assistant
  monique.acosta@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1173

  Jack Chiang, Associate Zoning Administrator
summary: Appeal of Zoning Administrator's approval to allow a wireless telecommunications facility on the rooftop of a residential building at 2069 North Argyle Avenue.
